prereq: Stage 0 的 12 个任务、原型、协议、评测与安全基线已经评审通过。
默认任务楔子是研究/文档整理；如果首位用户更依赖代码任务，可以替换楔子，但纵向结构不能改变。
本地开发环境、SQLite、可隔离 workspace 和 Web 构建链路可用。
contracts: Event Log 是事实源；SQLite WAL 保存事件与投影，SSE 支持断线续传。
Task/Run 只能通过受控迁移变化；刷新、重启和崩溃后都能从事实源重建。
外部动作必须经过 Effect Preview、outbox、幂等键和 Receipt，结果不确定时先对账。
秘密不进入任务卡、日志、模型上下文或执行器工作区；凭据只能由 Broker 注入。
failures: 任务详情显示最后已知状态、未完成步骤和“继续/取消/重试”。
从 Event Log 重放并重新领取 lease，禁止静默丢弃任务。
系统显示“正在对账”，不生成第二个成功回执。
按幂等键查询 sink，确认已完成后补写 Receipt 或走补偿。
任务进入“等待确认”，隐藏自动重试按钮。
先查询外部系统或人工核对，再决定重试、补偿或关闭。
exclusions: 不允许只靠 CLI、日志或数据库证明 MVP 可用。
不在恢复与审批未稳定前扩大任务族。
不把永久 mock 结果当成真实执行。

prereq: Stage 0's 12 tasks, prototype, protocols, evaluation, and safety baseline have passed review.
The default wedge is research/document work; if the first user mainly needs coding, replace the wedge without changing the vertical structure.
A local development environment, SQLite, isolated workspaces, and the Web build are available.
contracts: The Event Log is the source of truth; SQLite WAL stores events and projections; SSE resumes after disconnects.
Task/Run changes only through controlled transitions and can be rebuilt after refresh, restart, or crash.
External actions pass through Effect Preview, outbox, idempotency key, and Receipt; reconcile uncertain results first.
Secrets never enter task cards, logs, model context, or executor workspaces; only the Broker injects credentials.
failures: The detail page shows the last known state, unfinished step, and Continue/Cancel/Retry.
Replay the Event Log and reacquire the lease; never silently drop the task.
The system shows Reconciling and does not create a second success receipt.
Query the sink by idempotency key, then write the Receipt or start compensation.
The task enters Waiting for confirmation and hides automatic retry.
Query the external system or check manually before retry, compensation, or closure.
exclusions: Do not prove MVP readiness through CLI, logs, or database rows alone.
Do not expand task families before recovery and approval are stable.
Do not treat permanent mock output as real execution.

zh.title: 可运行走路骨架
zh.lead: 先让最小的真实路径站起来：Web 创建任务，持久状态推进，刷新或重启后仍然存在。
zh.outcome: 用户可以在真实 Web 页面创建任务，看到排队、执行、完成，并在刷新或重启后继续找到它。
steps: 启动 hearthd 单进程，明确本地端口、数据目录、健康检查与日志位置。
接入 SQLite WAL、最小 Event Log 和可重建的读取投影。
实现 Task/Run 最小状态机，所有迁移写入事件而不是直接改状态列。
用 fake executor 产生真实执行事件，覆盖成功和至少一个失败路径。
Web 接入任务列表、详情、创建和 SSE，刷新页面后从持久状态恢复。
提供最小 CLI，只用于诊断、重放和健康检查，不作为产品主入口。
zh.gate: 主路径不依赖手工改数据库；服务重启后任务与状态可恢复；任务卡显示真实状态而不是静态 mock；UI 契约测试通过。
evidence: 最小 Event Log 与投影
重启恢复演示与契约测试

en.title: Runnable walking skeleton
en.lead: Stand up the smallest real path first: create a task in the Web app, advance durable state, and keep it after refresh or restart.
en.outcome: A user can create a task in the real Web app, watch it queue, run, and complete, and find it again after refresh or restart.
steps: Start a single hearthd process with explicit local port, data directory, health check, and log location.
Add SQLite WAL, a minimal Event Log, and rebuildable read projections.
Implement the minimum Task/Run state machine; every transition writes an event instead of mutating a status column directly.
Use a fake executor to produce real execution events, covering success and at least one failure path.
Connect Web task list, detail, creation, and SSE, restoring from durable state after refresh.
Provide a minimal CLI for diagnostics, replay, and health checks only, never as the product entry.
en.gate: The main path needs no manual database edits; tasks and states survive restart; cards show real rather than static mock state; UI contract tests pass.

zh.title: 第一个真实 Codex 纵向切片
zh.lead: 把 fake executor 换成真实 Codex，在受控 workspace 中完成首批可验证的真实任务。
zh.outcome: 用户提交本地资料，得到带引用的结构化产物；任务卡显示阶段、产物、验证结果和成本。
steps: 实现 Codex adapter，加入版本检查、健康检查、超时、取消和失败分类。
为每次运行创建一次性 workspace，限制可读范围，保留输入与产物的来源关系。
生成 Task Pack，约束结构化输出、引用格式、文件清单和完成条件。
记录 Artifact、来源、哈希和验证结果，拒绝无依据的引用或缺失文件。
把执行事件投影到任务时间线，采集 Token、延迟、模型与执行器信息。
对失败结果给出用户可理解的类别和下一步，不用永久 mock 掩盖真实问题。
zh.gate: 首批真实任务端到端可用；产物可打开和验证；引用或文件证据可追溯；失败时 UI 显示类别和下一步；不使用永久 mock 结果。
evidence: Task Pack 与结构化结果
首批真实任务演示与成本记录

en.title: First real Codex vertical slice
en.lead: Replace the fake executor with real Codex and complete the first verifiable real tasks inside a controlled workspace.
en.outcome: A user submits local materials and receives structured artifacts with citations; the task card shows stages, artifacts, verification, and cost.
steps: Implement the Codex adapter with version checks, health checks, timeout, cancellation, and failure classification.
Create a disposable workspace per run, limit readable scope, and preserve input-to-artifact provenance.
Generate a Task Pack that constrains structured output, citations, file manifest, and completion conditions.
Record Artifact, source, hash, and verification results; reject unsupported citations or missing files.
Project execution events into the task timeline and capture Token, latency, model, and executor data.
Explain failures with user-facing classes and next actions; never hide real problems behind permanent mocks.
en.gate: The first real-task set works end to end; artifacts open and verify; citations or file evidence are traceable; failures show class and next step; no permanent mock result remains.
evidence: First real-task demo and cost record

zh.title: MVP 收口
zh.lead: 把已经跑通的任务路径收口成一个可以每天使用的最小产品，而不是一个只能演示的后端切片。
zh.outcome: Hearth MVP-1 可用：创建、查看、取消、重试、审批演练、取回产物和恢复都在浏览器中完成。
steps: 补齐持久 Run、取消、重试、任务详情、时间线和产物中心。
实现失败恢复页、预算上限与异常停止，确保用户知道任务为何停下。
加入练习 Effect 的预览、批准、拒绝和回执，不产生真实外部影响。
完善基础失败分类、空状态、加载状态和用户可见的原因说明。
用至少 5 个代表性真实任务验收，其中 3 个重复运行稳定，四个关键中断点均可恢复。
确认用户明确愿意继续使用，且没有未受控的真实副作用。
zh.gate: 至少 5 个代表性真实任务通过；其中 3 个重复运行稳定；四个关键中断点均可恢复；用户明确愿意继续使用；没有未受控真实副作用。

en.title: MVP closeout
en.lead: Close the working path into a minimum daily product, not a backend slice that only works in a demo.
en.outcome: Hearth MVP-1 works: create, inspect, cancel, retry, rehearse approval, retrieve artifacts, and recover entirely in the browser.
steps: Complete durable Run, cancel, retry, task detail, timeline, and artifact center.
Add failure recovery, budget limits, and abnormal stops so users know why work stopped.
Add preview, approve, reject, and receipt for a practice Effect with no real external impact.
Complete basic failure classes, empty states, loading states, and user-visible explanations.
Validate with at least five representative real tasks; three repeat reliably; all four critical interruption points recover.
Confirm that the user explicitly wants to keep using it and that no uncontrolled real side effect exists.
en.gate: Five representative real tasks pass; three repeat reliably; four critical interruptions recover; the user wants to continue; no uncontrolled real side effect exists.

zh.title: 副作用安全骨架
zh.lead: 在第一次真实外部写入之前，先证明系统能预览影响、绑定审批、避免重复动作，并对不确定结果进行对账。
zh.outcome: 用户可以预览“将发生什么”，批准或拒绝，并在之后看到回执；重试不会造成第二次外部动作。
steps: 实现 Policy 与 Mandate v0，明确谁可以批准什么范围、强度和有效期的动作。
实现 Effect Preview，展示目标、参数、影响、不可逆性和补偿方式。
建立类型化 Effect、outbox、幂等键、Receipt 和测试 Effect sink。
加入 Credential Broker 接口，秘密只按最小权限注入，不进入模型与日志。
把审批绑定到真实参数、nonce 和过期时间，禁止复用旧批准。
对崩溃后重投、死信和结果不确定状态提供查询、对账与人工处理入口。
zh.gate: 审批与真实参数绑定；重复投递不产生重复副作用；崩溃后能安全重投；死信可查看和人工处理；秘密不出现在任务卡、日志或执行器上下文中。

en.title: Side-effect safety skeleton
en.lead: Before the first real external write, prove the system can preview impact, bind approval, prevent duplicate actions, and reconcile uncertainty.
en.outcome: A user can preview what will happen, approve or reject it, then see a receipt; retry never causes a second external action.
steps: Implement Policy and Mandate v0 with explicit scope, strength, expiry, and who can approve.
Implement Effect Preview showing target, parameters, impact, reversibility, and compensation.
Create typed Effects, outbox, idempotency keys, Receipts, and a test Effect sink.
Add a Credential Broker interface that injects secrets with least privilege only, outside model and logs.
Bind approval to real parameters, nonce, and expiry; reject reuse of an old approval.
Provide query, reconciliation, and manual handling for redelivery, dead letters, and uncertain results after a crash.
en.gate: Approval binds to real parameters; redelivery creates no duplicate effect; crash recovery can safely retry; dead letters are inspectable; secrets stay out of cards, logs, and executor context.

zh.title: 跨行业任务覆盖与内核加固
zh.lead: 证明内核不是为一个演示任务量身定制的：覆盖多个真实任务族，并用故障注入检验恢复能力。
zh.outcome: 文档、网页、研发协作、数据/财务等任务族通过同一任务卡模型完成；失败任务更容易恢复。
steps: 从 eval/ 的 15 个任务中选择至少两个与首批不同的任务族，复用 Task Pack、审批、产物和验证模型。
加入 diff、测试结果和结构化结果验证，确保新增任务族不是低标准拼接。
实现 lease 与 fencing token，防止旧 worker 在接管后继续写入。
执行 kill -9、断网、超时、磁盘满和重复投递等故障注入。
补齐备份恢复、更完整的失败分类、降级路径和用户可理解的修复建议。
回归所有已覆盖任务族，确认状态与事实源一致，失败不需要人工重建。
zh.gate: 已覆盖的多个任务族都能端到端完成；恢复率达到阶段门槛；重复外部副作用为 0；任务状态与事实源一致；失败不需要人工重建状态。
evidence: 跨行业任务族端到端演示

en.title: Cross-industry task coverage and kernel hardening
en.lead: Prove the kernel is not tailored to one demo task by covering multiple real task families and testing recovery through fault injection.
en.outcome: Document, web, engineering, and data/finance task families complete through the same task-card model, and failed tasks are easier to recover.
steps: Choose at least two task families from the 15 eval tasks that differ from the first batch, reusing Task Pack, approval, artifact, and verification models.
Add diff, test results, and structured-result verification so new families are not held to a lower standard.
Implement leases and fencing tokens so an old worker cannot keep writing after takeover.
Inject faults such as kill -9, network loss, timeout, disk full, and duplicate delivery.
Complete backup recovery, richer failure classes, degradation paths, and actionable repair suggestions.
Regress all covered task families and confirm state matches the source of truth without manual rebuild.
en.gate: All covered task families work end to end; recovery meets the stage target; duplicate external effects are zero; state matches events; failures need no manual rebuild.

zh.title: Stage 1 发布
zh.lead: 把 MVP 放进可长期试用的本地环境，完成范围、限制、安装、备份、升级与指标基线。
zh.outcome: 一个可以持续试用的本地产品，具备明确的范围、已知限制、恢复方式和指标基线。
steps: 跑 15 个真实任务，至少 10 个通过，覆盖多个任务族、失败、审批和恢复路径。
对比全人工和直接使用 Codex 的基线，记录人工分钟、成功率、Token 和失败类型。
修复高频失败与最影响信任的恢复问题，不扩大新的能力范围。
补全安装、备份、升级、数据导出和已知限制说明。
完成 Stage 1 安全与评测报告，明确下一阶段进入条件。
确认用户可独立使用，不依赖开发者手工运维或数据库操作。
zh.gate: Stage 1 退出条件全部满足；MVP 没有被后续内核工作破坏；用户能独立使用，不依赖开发者手工运维。
evidence: 15 个真实任务报告（至少 10 个通过）
安装/备份/升级/导出说明

en.title: Stage 1 release
en.lead: Put the MVP into a local environment that can be used repeatedly, with explicit scope, limits, install, backup, upgrade, and metric baselines.
en.outcome: A locally usable product with clear scope, known limits, recovery, and a metric baseline.
steps: Run 15 real tasks with at least 10 passing, covering multiple task families, failure, approval, and recovery paths.
Compare against manual and direct Codex baselines, recording minutes, success, Token, and failure types.
Fix high-frequency failures and trust-breaking recovery issues without expanding scope.
Complete install, backup, upgrade, data export, and known-limitations documentation.
Publish the Stage 1 safety and evaluation report with entry conditions for the next stage.
Confirm the user can operate it independently without developer maintenance or database edits.
en.gate: All Stage 1 exit conditions hold; later kernel work has not broken the MVP; the user can use it independently without developer operations.
evidence: 15 real-task report with at least 10 passes
